newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on selective buying.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange are expected to rise on buying of selective scrips, brokers said.

"The market will move forward with buying interest from retail investors. The institutional support is likely to help the market to rise," said broker Mahbub Morshed. Brokers said shares with a sound financial base in leather, food and pharmaceutical sectors might be attractive to small investors. But some engineering and real estate shares that gained over previous sessions were likely to fall on profit taking.
The DSE benchmark index lost 19.08 points or 1.57 percent at 1,197.6 on Sunday. Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Bangladesh.
